description: A shell script for testing and demonstrating git log options, commit graph creation, and merge behaviors, including functions for tagging and annotating commits, and various test scenarios with expected outputs.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Tags the current commit with a given tag name.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Generates a simplified annotation of commit history, cleaning up tag annotations.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Runs git log with specified parameters and compares output to expected.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Wrapper for check_outcome to verify successful git log output.
